decks.name: LeetCode #11 - Container With Most Water
decks.description: Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container that holds the most water

cards.question: Container With Most Water: You are given an integer array height of length n. There are n vertical lines drawn such that the two endpoints of the ith line are (i, 0) and (i, height[i]). Find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container, such that the container contains the most water. Return the maximum amount of water a container can store. Notice that you may not slant the container.

solutions.name: Two Pointers
solutions.explanation: Use two pointers starting from both ends. Calculate the area formed by the lines at the pointers. Move the pointer with the smaller height inward, as moving the larger height cannot increase the area. This greedy approach finds the maximum area in O(n) time.
